comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Primarily an electric power utility; its telecom operations are a secondary segment, unlike the target's pure connectivity business.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Sells billing, network and digital media software and outsourced operations to operators, not consumer or business connectivity service.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Operates rural wireless, fixed broadband and enterprise and government connectivity on its own networks, with owned retail stores, closely matching the target.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Regulated electric and natural gas utility; it sells energy, not telecommunications, broadband or managed IT services.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Diversified holding company whose main businesses are billboard advertising and insurance; broadband is only one segment.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Cloud phone and web hosting sold mainly to small businesses through partners; no owned network or consumer wireless base.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Designs session border controllers and communications software sold to carriers; a hardware and software vendor, not a network service provider.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Rural and suburban fiber internet, voice and video sold to households and small businesses over its own network, matching the target's model.

comps.label: C9
comps.reason: Wireless plus wireline broadband in rural and midsize markets, sold through owned stores to consumers, businesses and government, with managed IT.

comps.label: C10
comps.reason: Mainly a REIT leasing fiber and copper capacity to carriers under long-term contracts; retail broadband is a small side business.

comps.label: C11
comps.reason: Satellite broadband and defense communications using satellite fleets; differs in technology, end markets and customers from terrestrial Alaska telecom.

comps.label: C12
comps.reason: Makes network test equipment, optical security materials and fiber components; a manufacturer and supplier, not a connectivity service provider.
